# Trace library · things (desk, room, everyday carry)

An object is here because its owner did something. Below: trace → the causes that could have left it, with how much weight each cause carries.

44 entries. To add one: edit `src/traces/`, run `pnpm build:skill && pnpm test`, open a PR.

## desk

- **desk.dual-monitor**: Two or more monitors, or a monitor arm → Long hours at a computer with parallel windows (coding, design, trading, editing) (strong); Works from home with employer-paid gear (weak)
- **desk.mech-keyboard**: Mechanical keyboard, especially with custom keycaps → Programmer or heavy typist (medium); Hobbyist gear culture (keyboard community) (medium)
- **desk.keyboard-shine**: Keycap shine or wear concentrated on certain keys → Shine on WASD and space: long hours of gaming (strong); Even shine across letters: heavy typing (medium); Numpad wear: finance or data entry (medium)
- **desk.wrist-rest-wear**: Discolored or flattened wrist rest → Same posture at keyboard and mouse for hours daily (strong)
- **desk.mouse-left**: Mouse on the left side of the keyboard → Left-handed (strong); Right hand injured or deliberately switching hands (weak)
  - ⚠️ Front-camera selfies may be mirrored; desk photos usually are not
- **desk.cable-managed**: Cables routed with clips, trays, or ties → Order-loving tinkerer / engineer aesthetic (medium); Self-built setup rather than company-issued (medium)
  - ⚠️ Tangled cables are the base rate; mess on its own carries no information
- **desk.multi-cups**: Several cups or bottles at once → Rarely leaves the desk; cups pile up (medium); Sole user of the desk, nobody to nag (weak)
- **desk.thermos-tea**: Thermos with loose tea leaves or goji berries → Older, or into wellness habits (medium)
  - applies to: mainland China
- **desk.coffee-gear**: Pour-over kettle, grinder, drip bags, capsule machine → Coffee dependency, first thing in the morning (strong); Spends on ritual and gear (weak)
- **desk.energy-drinks**: Empty energy drink cans → Late-night crunch, overtime, or all-night gaming (medium); Student cramming (weak)
- **desk.sticky-notes**: Sticky notes along the monitor bezel → Todo-driven, relies on external memory (medium); Notes are commands/shortcuts/logins: onboarding or juggling systems (weak)
- **desk.plant-healthy**: Plants thriving → Steady care routine; spends a lot of time at home (medium)
- **desk.plant-dead**: Dead plant, or plastic plants → Travels often, rarely home, or bought-and-forgot (medium)
- **desk.laptop-stickers**: Stickers on the laptop lid → Tech conference / open-source / language logos: developer (strong); Band / anime / brand stickers: subculture identity, younger (medium)
- **desk.two-laptops**: Two laptops, one with an asset tag → Work laptop plus personal laptop; remote or hybrid work (strong)
- **desk.baby-items**: Baby monitor, bottle, or kids toys in frame → Has a young child; desk sits in living space (strong)
- **desk.cat-signs**: Cat hair, scratcher, cat tree, or a cat on the keyboard → Has a cat (strong); Cat on keyboard: the computer never gets put away; cat outranks work (weak)
- **desk.dog-signs**: Dog bed, leash, dog hair → Has a dog; daily walks set the schedule (strong)
- **desk.gaming-setup**: Gaming chair, RGB lighting, controller, headset stand → Gaming is the main hobby; younger (medium)
- **desk.ergo-chair**: Premium ergonomic chair → Sedentary job, spends on the body, or company-issued (medium); Has paid the price of sitting before (weak)
  - ⚠️ Not a health inference: say only that they spent money on sitting comfortably
- **desk.exam-books**: Exam prep books (grad entrance, CPA, IELTS, civil service) → Preparing for an exam; at a life transition (strong); Still shrink-wrapped: bought, not started (medium)
  - applies to: mainland China
- **desk.book-condition**: Books worn with index tabs, or pristine rows → Worn and tabbed: actually read and annotated (strong); Pristine rows: decor or hoarding (medium)
- **desk.books-domain**: Books clustered in one field → Profession or a serious hobby in that field (strong)
- **desk.tablet-pencil**: Tablet with a stylus → Student note-taking, drawing, or reading papers (medium)
- **desk.mic-light-cam**: Studio mic, ring light, external webcam → Creates content (streaming/podcast/video) or lives in meetings (strong)
- **desk.multi-phones**: Two or more phones → Work phone plus personal phone (sales, ops, support) (medium); Developer test devices (medium)
- **desk.dust-gradient**: Some items dust-free while their surroundings are dusty → Clean things are used daily; dusty things were bought and abandoned (strong)
  - ⚠️ A classic Holmesian trace: what is worn tells you more than what is owned
- **desk.takeout**: Takeout containers, disposable cutlery → Eats at the desk; rarely cooks (medium); More likely lives alone (weak)
- **desk.figures**: Figures, blind boxes, Lego, merch → Anime/collector circles; neat arrangement means curated display (medium)
- **desk.travel-receipts**: Boarding pass, tickets, hotel key card, parking stub → Traveled recently; date and place readable from the ticket (strong)
  - source: Elementary S1E1
- **desk.lamp-daytime**: Desk lamp on in daytime, curtains drawn → Night-owl schedule, or light-sensitive (weak)
- **desk.medication**: Pill bottles, supplements → Off-limits: never infer health; supplements at most weakly suggest wellness habits (weak)
  - ⚠️ Sensitive category, see SENSITIVE_BLOCKLIST: skip it entirely

## devices

- **devices.phone-scratches**: Phone heavily scratched, no case → Kept in the same pocket as keys and coins; careless with things (medium); Second-hand or a hand-me-down (weak)
  - source: Sherlock S1E1
- **devices.charging-port-scuffs**: Ring of scuff marks around the charging port → Unsteady hands when plugging in at night (tired, dim light, poor eyesight) (medium)
  - source: Sherlock S1E1
  - ⚠️ The show inferred alcoholism, which is off limits here; write only 'plugs it in with an unsteady hand'
- **devices.apple-ecosystem**: All-Apple devices → Apple ecosystem user; design/creative/tech more likely (medium)
  - applies to: tier-1 Chinese cities
- **devices.cable-count**: Many charging cables with different connectors → Many devices; old ones never retired (medium)
- **devices.old-hardware-kept**: Piles of old phones, drives, routers → Techie "might need it someday" hoarding (medium); Rarely moves; long tenure at this address (weak)

## room

- **room.bed-made**: Bed made → Disciplined habit, or military/boarding-school background (weak)
- **room.things-in-pairs**: Two chairs, two sets of cutlery, cups in pairs → Shares the space or has a partner (medium)
- **room.moving-boxes**: Unopened boxes, bare walls → Just moved in, or renting without intent to stay (strong)
- **room.wall-decor**: Posters, art, or a photo wall → Long tenure, treats it as home; content points to interests (medium)
- **room.window-highrise**: Dense high-rises outside the window → Lives in a dense urban core (medium)
  - applies to: mainland China

## bag

- **bag.keychain**: What hangs on the keychain → Car key brand: owns a car, tier readable (strong); Many access cards: commutes through several buildings (medium); Tools (opener, knife, USB stick): practical type (medium)
- **bag.everyday-carry**: Bag contents laid out: power bank, earbuds, tissues, umbrella → Long commute (power bank, earbuds) (medium); Always carries an umbrella: rainy city, or learned the hard way (weak)
